integrity: Exact derivation via logical stabilizer code, Pauli postselection, and qubit Bloch octahedron; symbolic checks are supplementary. Existing numerical/qualitative observations and the underlying Hubbard spectrum are fully credited. No independent audit or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed one-up/one-down canonical four-qubit Hubbard sector, repulsive interaction, conventional qubit stabilizer polytope; detects presence/absence of magic, not its positive magnitude. No unrestricted ensemble, dynamical quench, or superselection variant is covered.
title: Exact thermal-magic boundary for the canonical Hubbard dimer
